pack-land: A mystical sealed pack landing with a soft low magical thud and a faint ring of crystal, a gentle arcane resonance.
pack-hover: A tiny soft magical shimmer, a faint glassy sparkle whisper, very short.
tear-scrub: Continuous crackling of magical energy tearing, sparkling arcane static and rustling foil, steady and loopable.
tear: A fast tearing of magical foil with a crackle of arcane energy and a rising sparkle at the end.
pack-burst: A burst of arcane energy: a rising whoosh, shimmering sparkles, a crystal chime swell and a soft airy magical release, fantasy spell reveal.
cards-slide: Enchanted cards gliding out with a soft whispery magical swish and tiny sparkles.
deal: A card whisking through the air with a clear airy whoosh and a faint sparkle, short, clearly audible.
flip: A card flipping over with a soft whoosh and a small crystalline tick, very short.
uncommon: A single soft crystal bell chime with a faint shimmer tail.
rare: A radiant harp glissando rising into a bright crystal chime with a sparkling tail, magical rare card reveal.
mythic: A huge mystical reveal: a deep resonant gong, an ethereal choir-like pad swelling, a cascading harp and a glittering sparkle burst, legendary spell cast.
select: A soft glassy crystal tick with a tiny sparkle. Very short.
deselect: A soft, low, muted glassy tick, like a fingertip dulling a crystal, clearly audible but gentle, with a short soft decay.
pick: Magic being sealed into a deck: a whoosh into a soft low thrum with a tiny sparkle, satisfying.
burn: A card consumed by arcane flame: a magical fire whoosh, crackle and a rising ember shimmer.
pack-arrive: A magical whoosh of a pack gliding in and settling with a soft glassy chime.
pack-pass: A magical swish of a pack gliding away with a faint sparkle trail.
tick: A single loud clear crystal glass tap with a short ringing decay, like a countdown beep. Dry, no music.
tap: A card turning sideways with a soft magical whisper and a small tick.
zoom-open: A rising airy magical whoosh with a gentle crystal shimmer, like a spell revealing a card up close, short.
zoom-close: A soft descending airy whoosh with a muted shimmer fading away, a magical vision closing, short.
row-hover: A faint tiny sparkle, a barely audible glassy twinkle, extremely short.
turn-over: A magical flip: a soft whoosh and a glassy swirl of sparkle as a card transforms to its other side.
